sentences.zh: 如果你想想罗斯福政府当时在尝试做什么，他们是在试图为民众建立某种基本的公共社会安全网，以保护他们

sentences.zh: 他们真的不希望政府介入他们的业务，甚至可能让他们的生计变得更加艰难。

sentences.en: We are rightly proud of the high standards of medical care we know how to provide in the United States.
sentences.zh: 我们理应为我们在美国所掌握的高标准医疗水平感到自豪。

sentences.zh: 因此，下一位真正着手尝试这一点的美国总统是哈里·杜鲁门。

sentences.zh: 我们的最终目标必须是一个包容性的保险系统，平等地保护我们所有人免受动荡和疾病的困扰。

sentences.zh: 随后，约翰·肯尼迪采取了大动作，试图扩大政府医疗保险的覆盖范围，至少针对老年人。

sentences.en: There was a view that while health insurance was starting to become available as a way for working people to protect themselves, that once you got old and you didn't have a job
sentences.zh: 当时有一种观点认为，虽然医疗保险开始作为劳动人民自我保护的一种方式变得可用，但一旦你老了，不再拥有附带保险的工作，

sentences.en: But he couldn't get it through.
sentences.zh: 但他没能让它获得通过。

sentences.zh: 老年美国人将不再被剥夺现代医学的治愈奇迹。

sentences.zh: 直到后来林登·约翰逊成为总统，并且民主党在国会取得压倒性多数之后，才得以实现。

sentences.en: No longer will illness crush and destroy the savings that they have so carefully put away over a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 疾病将不再无情摧毁他们一生小心翼翼积攒下来的储蓄。

sentences.zh: 他们终于能够通过立法，确立了我们现在所称的

sentences.zh: 这个国家将不再对那些为这个进步国家的进步奉献了一生服务、智慧和劳动的人们拒绝伸出公正之手。

sentences.zh: 当时的想法是，每个人只要年满 65 岁，如果他们工作并缴纳了工资税，就能够获得政府医疗保险。

sentences.zh: 他们将获得能够支付住院费用和看病费用的保险。

sentences.zh: 但为什么在全民医疗、政府运营医疗保健的这段时期，这个理念被限制在如此一小群美国人身上？

sentences.en: I think the idea has always been pretty politically controversial.
sentences.zh: 我认为这个想法在政治上一直具有相当大的争议。

sentences.en: There are a couple of different threads of it.

sentences.zh: 一方面是行业不喜欢它。

sentences.en: So doctors are the kind of most vocal group in this period.

sentences.en: away from them.

sentences.zh: 我也认为，尤其是在这一时期，人们对社会主义存在真正的抵触情绪，

sentences.en: idea that it's not American to have the government providing these basic benefits, that the free market should work to do it instead.
sentences.zh: 认为由政府提供这些基本福利是不符合美国精神的，自由市场应该取而代之发挥作用。

sentences.en: But what about the people who are being covered by government-run health care programs like Medicare?
sentences.zh: 但是那些被联邦医疗保险等政府运营的医疗保健计划覆盖的人呢？

sentences.zh: 在20世纪60年代、70年代这段时期，它对他们来说运作良好吗？

sentences.en: Medicare is a uniquely popular government program.
sentences.zh: 联邦医疗保险是一个极其受欢迎的政府项目。

sentences.en: People really love it.
sentences.zh: 人们真的很喜欢它。

sentences.en: It provides them with a lot of financial security.
sentences.zh: 它为他们提供了很多财务安全感。

sentences.en: People pay taxes into the program, so they feel like it's an earned benefit.
sentences.zh: 人们向该项目缴纳税款，所以他们觉得这是一项赚得的福利。

sentences.en: It's something that they deserve.
sentences.zh: 这是他们应得的。

sentences.en: But meanwhile, everyone else is in a health insurance program that is getting a little bit more rickety.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，其他所有人都在参加一个变得越来越摇摇欲坠的医疗保险计划。

sentences.en: There are some people who get really great insurance through their work, but there are a lot of other people who are sort of falling through the cracks with their between jobs if

sentences.en: they work for a company that doesn't provide insurance.
sentences.zh: 如果他们为不提供保险的公司工作。

sentences.zh: 我们其余人的体制是，这完全取决于你是谁、你为谁工作以及你的财务状况如何。

sentences.en: I've been able to receive it for myself and for my family, just like all of us who are on the tip of the iceberg, way up high in the health care services.
sentences.zh: 我能够为自己和我的家人获得它，就像我们所有处于冰山尖端、高高站在医疗服务行业顶端的人一样。

sentences.en: And because of that, there are a bunch of proposals over the years to try to reconsider a more national health care system.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，多年来提出了一系列旨在重新审视更全面的国家医疗系统的提案。

sentences.en: But I want every delegate at this convention to understand that as long as I'm a vote...
sentences.zh: 但我希望这次大会上的每一位代表都明白，只要我有一票……

sentences.en: So I would say the next big thing that happens in this timeline is that we get the Affordable
sentences.zh: 所以我可以说，这个时间线上发生下一件大事是我们在 2010 年迎来了《平价医疗法案》。

sentences.en: Care Act in 2010.
sentences.zh: 《平价医疗法案》于2010年出台。

sentences.en: And millions of Americans finally had the same chance to buy quality, affordable health care, and the peace of mind that comes with it is everybody else.
sentences.zh: 数百万美国人终于有了和其他人一样购买优质、负担得起的医疗保险的机会，以及随之而来的内心的平静。

sentences.en: There is a brief discussion among Democrats at that time of trying to do a single-payer system, a more universal system where everyone gets something like Medicare.
sentences.zh: 当时民主党内部曾进行过短暂的讨论，试图推行单一支付方系统、一种每个人都能获得类似联邦医疗保险的更普遍的系统。

sentences.en: But that really, even at that time, is very much a fringe view among Democrats.

sentences.en: The consensus idea that President Obama and the Democrats in Congress want to do is something
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统和国会民主党人希望达成的共识是某种

sentences.en: that sort of expands on our current system, where you still have a lot of different private insurers.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上扩展我们现有系统的方案，即你仍然拥有许多不同的私人保险公司。

sentences.en: So with the Affordable Care Act, once again, the concept of government-run health care is proposed and ultimately tossed aside.
sentences.zh: 因此，随着《平价医疗法案》的出台，政府运营医疗保健的概念再次被提出，最终又被抛弃。

sentences.en: Yes and no.
sentences.zh: 既是也不是。

sentences.en: I think you have to see the Affordable Care Act as a sort of compromise, as a moderate proposal that expands some government health care, expands some private insurance,
sentences.zh: 我认为你必须将《平价医疗法案》看作是一种妥协，看作是一个温和的提案，它扩大了一些政府医疗保健，扩大了一些私人保险，

sentences.zh: 保留了许多已经存在的东西，并没有夺走人们的东西。

sentences.en: But I also think that it did change Americans' expectations about what the role for government was in health care and also what kind of health care they were entitled to.
sentences.zh: 但我也认为它确实改变了美国人对政府在医疗保健中所扮演角色的期望，以及他们有权获得什么样的医疗保健。

sentences.en: So, you know, we're moving closer to the idea that everyone should be able to have health insurance, even if they're poor, even if they don't get insurance through work.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们正在朝着这样一个理念迈进：每个人都应该能够拥有医疗保险，即使他们很穷，即使他们没有通过工作获得保险。

sentences.en: And there are certain guarantees in the Affordable Care Act, like the guarantee that people who have pre-existing health conditions should be able to buy insurance.
sentences.zh: 《平价医疗法案》中有某些保障，比如患有既往健康状况的人应该能够购买保险的保障。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That really didn't exist before.
sentences.zh: 这在以前确实是不存在的。

sentences.en: So even though with the Affordable Care Act, we didn't end up with government-run health care, we end up with more government in our health care,
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管通过《平价医疗法案》，我们最终并没有实行政府运营的医疗保健，但我们的医疗保健中有了更多的政府参与，

sentences.en: which it sounds like is beginning to change people's perception of what the government's role should be when it comes to medicine.
sentences.zh: 听起来这开始改变人们对政府在医学领域应该扮演什么角色的看法。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Who are you guys here to see?
sentences.zh: 你们今天是来见谁的？

sentences.en: Who feels a burn?
sentences.zh: 谁感觉到了炙热？

sentences.en: And I think this lays the groundwork for Bernie Sanders when he comes forward with a proposal in 2016 that he calls Medicare for All.
sentences.zh: 我认为这为伯尼·桑德斯在 2016 年提出他称之为“全民医保”的提案奠定了基础。

sentences.en: We must fight to make sure that we pass a Medicare for All health care system.
sentences.zh: 我们必须为确保通过全民医保系统而战。

sentences.en: Medicare for All builds on the idea that everyone should have access to affordable health insurance, but it kind of turbocharges that idea.
sentences.zh: 全民医保建立在每个人都应该获得负担得起的医疗保险的理念之上，但它在某种程度上为这个理念按下了涡轮增压。

sentences.en: Medicare for All says everyone gets the same health care.
sentences.zh: 全民医保表示每个人都得到相同的医疗保健。

sentences.en: I happen to believe, and I know not everybody agrees with me, I believe that health care is a right of all people.
sentences.zh: 我碰巧相信，我知道并非所有人都同意我的看法，我相信医疗保健是所有人的一项权利。

sentences.en: Excuse me, where did that right come from in your mind?
sentences.zh: 请问，在你看来，这种权利是从哪里来的？

sentences.en: Being a human being.
sentences.zh: 作为一个人类。

sentences.en: Being a human being.
sentences.zh: 作为一个人类。

sentences.en: Senator Sanders' idea is that everyone in America would have access to health insurance that's provided by the government that covers a wide array of medical services
sentences.zh: 桑德斯参议员的想法是，美国每个人都能获得由政府提供的医疗保险，该保险涵盖广泛的医疗服务，

sentences.en: and for which they do not have to pay any money when they go to the doctor.
sentences.zh: 并且他们在去看医生时无需支付任何费用。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And what's the reaction to Sanders' proposal?
sentences.zh: 大家对桑德斯的提案有什么反应？

sentences.en: It has a really mixed reception.
sentences.zh: 反响非常复杂。

sentences.en: So I think that it really speaks to some people who respond to the moral case that he's making and to people who have really felt left behind by our current system,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为它确实引起了某些人的共鸣，他们对他的道德主张做出回应，还有那些真正感到被我们当前系统抛在后面的人，

sentences.en: who are struggling with high health care costs or fighting with their insurance companies.
sentences.zh: 他们正在与高昂的医疗费用作斗争，或者与保险公司争论不休。

sentences.en: So I think it really galvanized this campaign.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为它确实极大地激发了这场竞选的活力。

sentences.en: It's a central theme.
sentences.zh: 这是一个核心主题。

sentences.en: Obviously, he really outperforms everyone's expectations in the Democratic primary.
sentences.zh: 显然，他在民主党初选中确实超出了所有人的预期。

sentences.en: At the same time, I think that the kinds of people who were uncomfortable with the Affordable Care Act,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我认为那些对《平价医疗法案》感到不自在的人，

sentences.en: who were uncomfortable with some of these more universal health care systems in the past, think it's sort of a laughable idea.
sentences.zh: 以及过去对其中某些更普遍的全民医疗体系感到不自在的人，会觉得这是一种荒谬的想法。

sentences.en: It's really, really far from where we are right now.
sentences.zh: 这离我们现在的处境真的、真的很远。

sentences.en: It's far from anything that's really been debated in a serious way in the Congress.
sentences.zh: 它远非国会中任何真正经过严肃辩论的事情。

sentences.en: And it would be extremely expensive to implement.
sentences.zh: 而且它的实施成本会极其高昂。

sentences.en: It would require huge tax increases.
sentences.zh: 这将需要大幅增税。

sentences.en: And that is the kind of political debate that doesn't typically get very far when it's outside the confines of a campaign.
sentences.zh: 而且这种政治辩论一旦脱离了竞选的范围，通常就不会有什么实质进展。

sentences.en: So we know Sanders loses the primary.
sentences.zh: 所以我们知道桑德斯输掉了初选。

sentences.en: And so his campaign ends.
sentences.zh: 于是他的竞选结束了。

sentences.en: What happens to Medicare for All after that?
sentences.zh: 之后“全民医保”会怎么样？

sentences.en: It's really interesting.
sentences.zh: 这真的很有趣。

sentences.en: Medicare for All gets more popular than ever.
sentences.zh: “全民医保”变得比以往任何时候都更受欢迎。

sentences.en: So, you know, it's not just that Sanders loses the primary to Hillary Clinton, who wants to do something much more moderate on health care,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，不仅是桑德斯在初选中输给了想要在医疗保健上采取更为温和立场的希拉里·克林顿，

sentences.en: but also Hillary Clinton loses the election to Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 而且希拉里·克林顿在选举中输给了唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: I'm going to repeal and replace your disastrous Obamacare.
sentences.zh: 我将废除并替换你们灾难性的奥巴马医改。

sentences.en: Much cheaper, much better.
sentences.zh: 便宜得多，好得多。

sentences.en: So you might think that this sort of really left-wing idea of doing a universal health care would just go away, but instead it starts to gain in popularity.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会认为这种推行全民医疗的极左思想会就此消失，但相反，它开始越来越受欢迎。

sentences.en: And we see this in a couple of different ways.
sentences.zh: 我们从几个不同的方面看到了这一点。

sentences.en: Public opinion surveys show steady and modest increases in the number of Americans who seem interested in this idea when they're asked about it.
sentences.zh: 民意调查显示，当被问及这一想法时，似乎感兴趣的美国人数量呈稳定而适度的增长。

sentences.en: And the other thing that happens is we start to see way more Democrats in Congress signing on to proposals like the Sanders proposal.
sentences.zh: 另一件事是，我们开始看到国会中有更多的民主党人签署支持像桑德斯提出的那样的提案。

sentences.en: So Sanders himself had a bill that he had brought forward in previous Congresses, and basically no one wanted to co-sign it.
sentences.zh: 因此，桑德斯本人在先前的国会中曾提出过一项法案，但基本上没有人愿意联署。

sentences.en: And then he brought it again in 2017.
sentences.zh: 然后在2017年他又重新提出了该法案。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden he had, I think, 16 co-sponsors, including lots of really ambitious Democratic senators that we expected to run for president,
sentences.zh: 突然之间，我想他拥有了16个联署人，其中包括许多我们原本预计会竞选总统、

sentences.en: and we now see are running for president.
sentences.zh: 而我们现在看到正在竞选总统的雄心勃勃的民主党参议员。

sentences.en: And there's a bill in the House that had been introduced year after year with very few co-sponsors.
sentences.zh: 众议院也有一项年复一年被提出但联署人寥寥无几的法案。

sentences.en: And all of a sudden, again, in 2017, we saw the majority of Democrats in the House were signing on to this bill.
sentences.zh: 突然之间，同样是在2017年，我们看到众议院中多数民主党人签署了这项法案。

sentences.en: How do you explain that shift?
sentences.zh: 你如何解释这种转变？

sentences.en: I definitely think that Sanders was part of it.
sentences.zh: 我绝对认为桑德斯是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: And if you talk to him, he definitely thinks he was part of it, that he really brought this into the mainstream of our political conversation.
sentences.zh: 如果你跟他谈谈，他绝对认为自己是其中的一部分，是他真正将这一点带入了我们政治对话的主流。

sentences.en: But I think there are a couple of other factors.
sentences.zh: 但我认为还有其他几个因素。

sentences.en: One is that after Trump became president, the first thing he tried to do in legislation was repeal the Affordable Care Act.
sentences.zh: 首先是特朗普当选总统后，他在立法上试图做的第一件事就是废除《平价医疗法案》。

sentences.en: And, you know, Republicans had a lot of indications that was going to be a good idea.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，共和党人有很多迹象表明这将是一个好主意。

sentences.en: Their voters had been telling them for years that they really didn't like Obamacare, and they wanted it to go away.
sentences.zh: 他们的选民多年来一直在告诉他们，他们真的很不喜欢奥巴马医改，希望它消失。

sentences.en: But actually, that turned out to be kind of politically perilous for the Republicans.
sentences.zh: 但事实上，事实证明这对共和党人来说是一种政治险境。

sentences.en: And today, the president summoned GOP lawmakers to the White House for the second time in less than a month after two versions of a bill to repeal and replace Obamacare failed.
sentences.zh: 今天，在两次旨在废除并替换奥巴马医改的法案版本失败后，总统在不到一个月的时间里第二次召集共和党议员前往白宫。

sentences.en: They failed multiple attempts to repeal the Affordable Care Act, and its popularity got higher than ever.
sentences.zh: 他们在多次试图废除《平价医疗法案》时都失败了，而该法案的受欢迎程度却比以往任何时候都高。

sentences.en: And there was kind of this boost among Democratic activists over health care, that they started to really care about the issue and get organized and get angry.
sentences.zh: 民主党激进人士在医疗保健问题上得到了某种鼓舞，他们开始真正关心这个问题，组织起来并感到愤怒。

sentences.en: Many of the Republican congressmen who held town halls during this recess have heard the wrath of many of their constituents.
sentences.zh: 在这次休会期间举行市民大会的许多共和党国会议员都听到了许多选民的愤怒声音。

sentences.en: And I think some of those people are bringing new energy to the single-payer moment.
sentences.zh: 我认为其中一些人为单一支付方运动带来了新的活力。

sentences.en: In North Dakota, Congressman Kevin Kramer heard from a woman with a disabled child.
sentences.zh: 在北达科他州，国会议员凯文·克雷默听取了一位育有残疾儿童的妇女的心声。

sentences.en: She asked him not to repeal Obamacare, with her family facing bankruptcy.
sentences.zh: 她要求他不要废除奥巴马医改，因为她的家庭面临着破产的边缘。

sentences.en: This is what $3.5 million looks like.
sentences.zh: 这就是350万美元的样子。

sentences.en: And she's two years old.
sentences.zh: 而她才两岁。

sentences.en: And then the third thing that I think that happens is the Democrats are kind of on their heels.
sentences.zh: 我认为发生的第三件事是民主党人处于防御状态。

sentences.en: They're not in control of Congress anymore.
sentences.zh: 他们不再掌控国会。

sentences.en: They're not in control of the White House.
sentences.zh: 他们不再掌控白宫。

sentences.en: They don't actually have to govern.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上不必执政。

sentences.en: And so I think that makes them a little bit more open to something that's more idealistic, that's more aspirational.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这让他们对一些更具理想主义、更有抱负的事物更加开放。

sentences.en: When they're in the minority, I think they can say, we want to tell you what our values are.
sentences.zh: 当他们处于少数地位时，我认为他们可以说，我们想告诉你我们的价值观是什么。

sentences.en: We want to tell you what our dreams are and what we care about equity and we care about fairness.
sentences.zh: 我们想告诉你我们的梦想是什么，我们关心平等，我们关心公平。

sentences.en: And they don't really have to worry about the dirty little details.
sentences.zh: 他们其实不必担心那些繁琐的小细节。

sentences.en: When our congressmen took a party-line vote that would have canceled health insurance for thousands of Virginians, I knew I had to run.
sentences.zh: 当我们的国会议员投下了一票党派票，取消了成千上万弗吉尼亚人的健康保险时，我知道我必须参选。

sentences.en: That's exactly what we saw happen in the midterMs.
sentences.zh: 这正是我们在中期选举中看到的情况。

sentences.en: Health care affects everyone.
sentences.zh: 医疗保健影响着每个人。

sentences.en: Making it into a partisan battle makes things worse.
sentences.zh: 把它变成一场党派斗争只会让事情变得更糟。

sentences.en: We saw a lot of Democrats all across the country running with health care as their primary message.
sentences.zh: 我们看到全国各地的许多民主党人将医疗保健作为他们的主要诉求进行竞选。

sentences.en: I'm voting for Mikey Sherrill because I know she'll fight for me and my family, my daughter, and for the ACA.
sentences.zh: 我投票给米基·雪rill，因为我知道她会为我、我的家人、我的女儿以及ACA而战。

sentences.en: And it was very effective.
sentences.zh: 而且这非常有效。

sentences.en: They took over a lot of seats in the House that had previously been held by Republicans.
sentences.zh: 他们夺回了众议院许多先前由共和党人把持的席位。

sentences.en: But I think the exact message that they drew from this is a little bit mixed.
sentences.zh: 但我认为他们从中得出的具体讯息有点复杂。

sentences.en: I think a lot of them felt, oh, people really just want me to protect what they already have, that we have a very good message in protecting the Affordable Care Act.
sentences.zh: 我想他们中的很多人觉得，哦，人们其实只是想让我保护他们已经拥有的东西，我们在保护《平价医疗法案》方面有一个非常好的诉求。

sentences.en: But some of these Democrats who won running on health care felt like this is a reason to go forward,
sentences.zh: 但其中一些凭借医疗保健议题赢得竞选的民主党人觉得，这是一个继续前进的理由，

sentences.en: to push further than the Affordable Care Act because the electorate really responds to this issue.
sentences.zh: 要比《平价医疗法案》走得更远，因为选民对这个议题反应强烈。

sentences.en: And I think you can really see this now as the 2020 presidential field is starting to heat up.
sentences.zh: 我想随着2020年总统竞选格局开始白热化，你现在真的可以看到这一点。

sentences.en: Senator Sanders obviously continues to support it.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯参议员显然继续支持它。

sentences.en: Cory Booker, the senator from New Jersey, is in favor of the Sanders proposal.
sentences.zh: 新泽西州参议员科里·布克赞成桑德斯的提案。

sentences.en: Elizabeth Warren was a co-sponsor of Senator Sanders' bill in the last Congress.
sentences.zh: 伊丽莎白·沃伦是上一届国会中桑德斯参议员法案的联署人。

sentences.en: But it is not universal among Democratic candidates.
sentences.zh: 但这在民主党候选人中并不是普遍共识。

sentences.en: We saw Amy Klobuchar, a Democratic senator from Minnesota, who said, this is too aspirational, it's too pie in the sky,
sentences.zh: 我们看到来自明尼苏达州的民主党参议员埃米·克洛布查尔说，这太好高骛远了，这只是空想，

sentences.en: we need to focus on more incremental changes that are more politically possible.
sentences.zh: 我们需要关注那些在政治上更具可行性的渐进式变革。

sentences.en: They all want to make some increase for the role of government, try to have there be more health care available for more people to make it more affordable.
sentences.zh: 他们都希望在某种程度上增强政府的作用，试图为更多人提供更多的医疗保健服务，使其更具可负担性。

sentences.en: But there is this range from little technocratic fixes to let's do single payer.
sentences.zh: 但这里存在一个区间，从微小的技术官僚式修补到让我们实行单一支付方。

sentences.en: Well, let's talk about that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我们来谈谈这个。

sentences.en: What does it mean when a candidate for the Democratic presidential primary in this moment says Medicare for All?
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，民主党总统初选候选人说“全民医保”意味着什么？

sentences.en: What are the actual proposals on the table?
sentences.zh: 桌面上实际的提案有哪些？

sentences.en: Oh, who knows?
sentences.zh: 噢，谁知道呢？

sentences.en: I mean, we are so big right now.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们现在规模太大了。

sentences.en: I think when Bernie Sanders says Medicare for All, we know what he means because he talked about it in 2016 and he has a legislative proposal.
sentences.zh: 我认为伯尼·桑德斯说“全民医保”时，我们知道他的意思，因为他在2016年谈论过，而且他有一项立法提案。

sentences.en: I think with a lot of these other candidates, they are kind of latching on to a brand name that seems to be pretty popular with the public
sentences.zh: 我认为对于其他许多候选人来说，他们有点在借用一个在公众中似乎很受欢迎的品牌名称，

sentences.en: that reminds them of Medicare, which a lot of people like.
sentences.zh: 这让他们想起了许多人喜欢的联邦医疗保险（Medicare）。

sentences.en: But we're not in the phase of the campaign yet where we have really specific proposals that tell us exactly what it is that they want to do.
sentences.zh: 但我们还没到竞选的那个阶段，无法拿出真正具体的提案来准确告诉我们他们到底想做什么。

sentences.en: To the degree that Medicare for All is an actual credible proposal, like what has been offered by Senator Bernie Sanders,
sentences.zh: 就“全民医保”作为一项真正可靠的提案而言，比如伯尼·桑德斯参议员所提出的，

sentences.en: how practical is it?
sentences.zh: 它有多大实用性？

sentences.en: How expensive would it be to create?
sentences.zh: 创建它的成本会有多高？

sentences.en: How disruptive would it be to the current health care system?
sentences.zh: 对当前的医疗保健系统会产生多大的颠覆性？

sentences.en: I think it's almost hard to underestimate how disruptive it would be.
sentences.zh: 我认为几乎很难低估它会带来的颠覆性。

sentences.en: Just to give one example, right now we have private health insurance companies that cover most Americans.
sentences.zh: 仅举一个例子，目前我们有私营医疗保险公司为大多数美国人提供保障。

sentences.en: These are big corporations.
sentences.zh: 这些都是大公司。

sentences.en: They're among the largest and moSt.
sentences.zh: 它们是其中最大的一些……

sentences.en: Aetna, Cigna, Blue Cross Blue Shield.
sentences.zh: 安泰保险、信诺、蓝十字蓝盾。

sentences.en: These companies would essentially be wiped out by the Sanders proposal.
sentences.zh: 桑德斯提案将基本上使这些公司灰飞烟灭。

sentences.en: There would be no private insurance.
sentences.zh: 将不再有私人保险。

sentences.en: Everyone would get their insurance directly from the government.
sentences.zh: 每个人都将直接从政府获得保险。

sentences.en: And what about the cost?
sentences.zh: 那么成本呢？

sentences.en: So this would be an enormously expensive proposal.
sentences.zh: 所以这将是一个成本极其高昂的提案。

sentences.en: It is not necessarily expensive compared to all the ways that Americans pay for health care now.
sentences.zh: 与美国人现在支付医疗费用的所有方式相比，它不一定昂贵。

sentences.en: So right now, your employer, if you get an employer-based insurance, they pay something towards your insurance premium.
sentences.zh: 所以现在，你的雇主，如果你有基于雇主的保险，他们会为你支付一部分保险费。

sentences.en: You pay something towards your insurance premium.
sentences.zh: 你也要支付一部分保险费。

sentences.en: When you go to the hospital, maybe you pay a deductible.
sentences.zh: 当你去医院时，也许你要支付免赔额。

sentences.en: They're kind of all of these different pots that your health care dollars come from.
sentences.zh: 你的医疗保健资金大体上来自所有这些不同的渠道。

sentences.en: What the Medicare for all plan would do is it would say, no one's going to pay into any of those streaMs.
sentences.zh: “全民医保”计划的作用是，它会说，没有人会再向任何这些渠道缴费了。

sentences.en: The federal government is going to pay for all the medical bills.
sentences.zh: 联邦政府将支付所有的医疗账单。

sentences.en: But in order to pay that, they have to collect way more money in taxes.
sentences.zh: 但为了支付这笔费用，他们必须在税收中收缴更多的资金。

sentences.en: So various estimates say it would cost more than $30 trillion to administer something like the Sanders plan.
sentences.zh: 因此，各种估计表明，实施类似桑德斯计划的成本将超过30万亿美元。

sentences.en: And that is a lot of money, and that is so much money that you can't just raise it by taxing the rich.
sentences.zh: 这是一大笔钱，这是一笔如此巨额的资金，以至于你不能仅仅通过对富人征税来筹集。

sentences.en: You would really have to have very broad-based taxes that would reach across the income spectrum.
sentences.zh: 你真的必须实行覆盖整个收入阶层的非常广泛的税收。

sentences.en: So what you have described is a pretty radical idea that would upend a huge segment of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以你所描述的是一个相当激进的想法，它将颠覆美国的一大片

sentences.en: economy.
sentences.zh: 经济。

sentences.en: It would require major changes to the tax code.
sentences.zh: 它需要对税法进行重大修改。

sentences.en: So I wonder if there's any practical chance that this actually could get through our legislative and political process to become the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以我怀疑这是否真的有任何现实的可能通过我们的立法和政治进程成为美国的

sentences.en: health care system.
sentences.zh: 医疗保健系统。

sentences.en: So I'm always wary of making political predictions, but it seems extremely unlikely to me right now for a couple of reasons.
sentences.zh: 所以我总是对做政治预测持谨慎态度，但基于几个原因，目前对我来说这似乎极其不可能。

sentences.en: One is that Republicans are dead set against this.
sentences.zh: 首先是共和党人坚决反对这一点。

sentences.en: So now we're left with just Democrats who would have to vote for such a bill.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我们只剩下必须投票支持这样一项法案的民主党人了。

sentences.en: And then you would have to imagine that they could all agree on a proposal this radical.
sentences.zh: 然后你必须想象他们都能就如此激进的提案达成一致。

sentences.en: And I don't think that there is enough unanimity among Democrats right now on this issue.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为民主党人目前在这个问题上还没有足够的共识。

sentences.en: But I also think that this is a way for Democratic politicians to signal that they are signed on to a particular set of values about fairness, about affordability,
sentences.zh: 但我也认为这是民主党政客发出信号的一种方式，表明他们赞同关于公平、关于可负担性的一套特定价值观，

sentences.en: about kind of all being in it together.
sentences.zh: 关于同舟共济的理念。

sentences.en: And I think that they want to send those kind of values messages to voters, even if they're not necessarily sending them a specific policy platform that they can deliver on.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们希望向选民传递这种价值观信息，即使他们不一定在向选民传递他们能够兑现的具体政策纲领。

sentences.en: And so I think it's a way to say, like, that's the mountaintop goal.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这是一种表达方式，比如，那是山顶的目标。

sentences.en: We're going to get there eventually.
sentences.zh: 我们最终会到达那里。

sentences.en: But it's not necessarily saying, you know, on day one, I'm going to get there right away.
sentences.zh: 但这并不一定意味着，你知道，在第一天，我就会马上实现它。

sentences.en: Well, what exactly does that path look like then from where we are in the minds of these Democratic candidates to a someday world where Medicare for all,
sentences.zh: 那么，从我们目前的处境来看，在这些民主党候选人的心目中，通往某天“全民医保”的道路到底是什么样的，

sentences.en: as envisioned by someone like Bernie Sanders, could ever be reality?
sentences.zh: 正如伯尼·桑德斯这样的人所设想的那样，这怎么可能成为现实？

sentences.en: So I had this really interesting and instructive experience about a year ago.
sentences.zh: 大约一年前，我有过一次非常有趣且富有启示意义的经历。

sentences.en: I went with Bernie Sanders to Toronto and we went on a tour of the Canadian health care system.
sentences.zh: 我和伯尼·桑德斯一起去了多伦多，我们参观了加拿大的医疗保健系统。

sentences.en: And I would say that Canada's system is the closest analog to what a lot of these politicians are proposing.
sentences.zh: 我想说的是，加拿大的系统是许多这些政客所提议的最接近的类似物。

sentences.en: And one thing that just really struck me about Canada is that people are all in on the values piece.
sentences.zh: 关于加拿大，有一件事真正震撼了我，那就是人们完全认同价值观的部分。

sentences.en: There is just a real sense of kind of social solidarity around the idea that health care is a right and everyone should have it in the country and there shouldn't be any restrictions and that it should be sort of radically fair.
sentences.zh: 围绕着医疗保健是一项权利、国家中的每个人都应该拥有它、不应该有任何限制而且应该极其公平这一理念，存在着一种真正的社会团结感。

sentences.en: And that just struck me culturally as so different.
sentences.zh: 在文化上，这让我觉得非常不同。

sentences.en: And the thing that I couldn't untangle when I was in Canada is do they have those values because they have that system or do they have that system because they already had those values?
sentences.zh: 我在加拿大时无法理清的一件事是，他们拥有这些价值观是因为他们拥有这个系统，还是因为他们已经拥有了这些价值观所以才有了这个系统？

sentences.en: And I think, you know, part of what will be interesting if Democrats, you know,
sentences.zh: 我认为，你知道，如果民主党人，你知道，

sentences.en: retake power and if they start moving us on this path towards something more like single payer is how hard will it be to shift those values?
sentences.zh: 重新夺回权力，如果他们开始推动我们走上这条更接近单一支付方的道路，其中一部分有趣之处在于，改变这些价值观会有多难？

sentences.en: We see them, you know, there is definitely are people in the Democratic base who believe them deeply in their hearts.
sentences.zh: 我们看到他们，你知道，民主党基石中确实有人在内心深处坚信这些。

sentences.en: But I don't think that most Americans feel that health care is a fundamental right and that everyone should have it.
sentences.zh: 但我不认为大多数美国人觉得医疗保健是一项基本权利，每个人都应该拥有它。

sentences.en: And I don't know if that will change.
sentences.zh: 我不知道这是否会改变。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Which comes first, the values that say that health care is a right or the national health care system that dictates that?
sentences.zh: 哪个先生？是宣称医疗保健是一项权利的价值观，还是规定这一点的国家医疗保健系统？

sentences.en: And from everything you've described, something like 80 years of U.S.
sentences.zh: 从你所描述的一切来看，美国大约80年的

sentences.en: history suggests that there has not been an appetite for this kind of a system.
sentences.zh: 历史表明，人们一直对这种系统缺乏热情。

sentences.en: So the only way it would work is if we believe, right, that the system could come first and the values would flow from it.
sentences.zh: 所以它能起作用的唯一途径是我们相信，对吧，系统可以先建立，然后价值观从中产生。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I almost think that the opposite thing is probably true, that it's really hard to imagine it being possible to pass something that would be so earth shattering,
sentences.zh: 我甚至认为相反的情况可能是真的，即很难想象通过一项如此具有颠覆性的法案会是可能的，

sentences.en: that would make so many changes to our health care system, to our tax code, to the way that health care is delivered if we don't have buy-in.
sentences.zh: 如果在我们没有得到广泛赞同的情况下，它会对我们的医疗保健系统、对我们的税法、对医疗保健的提供方式做出如此多的改变。

sentences.en: And so I think that a real challenge for politicians around this issue is really going to be winning hearts and minds and trying to convince people that this vision of how the health care system should work is worth the disruption.
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为政客们在这个问题上面临的真正挑战，将是真正赢得人心，并试图说服人们，这种关于医疗保健系统应如何运作的愿景值得承受这种颠覆。

sentences.en: The people who really believe in it really believe in it, but there are a lot of people that they will have to persuade.
sentences.zh: 那些真正相信它的人确实坚信不疑，但还有很多人是他们必须说服的。

sentences.en: It's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: So when candidates like Bernie Sanders say Medicare for all,
sentences.zh: 因此，当伯尼·桑德斯这样的候选人说“全民医保”时，

sentences.en: potentially he's actually trying to change the American culture to the point where Medicare for all could actually work.
sentences.zh: 潜在地，他实际上是在试图改变美国文化，直到“全民医保”真正能够行得通的程度。

sentences.en: In other words, when he or anyone says Medicare for all, they're actually calling for the cultural change required for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，当他或任何人提出“全民医保”时，他们实际上是在呼吁美国进行文化变革，

sentences.en: to get excited and adopt Medicare for all.
sentences.zh: 从而让美国人对接纳“全民医保”感到兴奋。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: I mean, it could be that this is the only way that we're going to get the kind of cultural change that would be required to make a policy change of this magnitude.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这可能是我们实现如此规模政策变革所需的唯一一种文化变革的方式。

sentences.en: But I also think that there are real risks here.
sentences.zh: 但我也认为这里面存在真正的风险。

sentences.en: It's totally possible that America could engage with this idea and we could have a big debate about it in a presidential election and then could thoroughly reject it.
sentences.zh: 完全有可能美国会接触这个想法，我们会在总统大选中对此进行激烈的辩论，然后彻底拒绝它。

sentences.en: And then we sort of end up with the kind of politics around health care that we've had for a long time, where these sort of universal health care proposals are put forward.
sentences.zh: 接着我们可能会回到过去长期存在的医疗保健政治状态，即提出这类全民医疗保健提案。

sentences.en: It's decided that they're kind of too radical for where we are and they get shelved again.
sentences.zh: 大家认为它们对于目前的现状来说过于激进，于是再次被搁置。

sentences.en: Which would put us in kind of a familiar situation of having considered a big government run health care system and saying, no, thanks.
sentences.zh: 这将使我们陷入一种熟悉的情境：考虑了一个由大政府运营的医疗保健系统，然后说，不用了，谢谢。

sentences.en: Margot, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 玛戈，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: I'm so happy to come on.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴能来参加节目。

sentences.en: In his new budget unveiled on Monday, President Trump called for eight hundred forty five billion dollars in cuts to Medicare over the next decade.
sentences.zh: 在周一公布的新预算中，特朗普总统要求在未来十年内削减8450亿美元的医疗保险预算。

sentences.en: Setting up a twenty twenty presidential race in which he will seek to shrink the program while many of his Democratic rivals propose expanding it.
sentences.zh: 这就为2020年总统竞选埋下了伏笔：他将寻求缩减该计划，而他的许多民主党竞争对手则提议扩大该计划。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app unlocked.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App解锁。

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month for free without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费体验《时报》一个月而无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在App内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》App，并获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, European governments, including Britain, France and Ireland,
sentences.zh: 周二，包括英国、法国和爱尔兰在内的欧洲政府

sentences.en: ordered that all Boeing 737 MAX 8s be grounded as global fears over their safety intensified after Sunday's deadly crash in Ethiopia.
sentences.zh: 下令将所有波音737 MAX 8飞机停飞，因为周日在埃塞俄比亚发生致命坠机事故后，全球对其安全性的担忧不断加剧。

sentences.en: The second such crash for the Boeing model in six months.
sentences.zh: 这是该波音机型在六个月内发生的第二起此类坠机事故。

sentences.en: The Times reports that nearly two thirds of the MAX 8 models in the world have now been pulled from use, but that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，全球近三分之二的MAX 8机型目前已停止使用，但美国

sentences.en: is still declining to ground the plane.
sentences.zh: 仍拒绝将该飞机停飞。

sentences.en: During a telephone call on Tuesday, the CEO of Boeing urged President Trump to allow the planes to remain in use, assuring him that they are safe to fly.
sentences.zh: 在周二的一通电话中，波音公司首席执行官敦促特朗普总统允许飞机继续使用，并向他保证这些飞机飞行安全。

sentences.en: And...
sentences.zh: 还有……

sentences.en: We're here today to announce charges in the largest college admissions scam ever prosecuted by the Department of Justice.
sentences.zh: 我们今天来到这里，是为了宣布对司法部起诉的有史以来最大规模的高校招生骗局提出指控。

sentences.en: The FBI has charged 50 people in a multi-million dollar bribery scheme to get wealthy children into prestigious colleges, including Yale, Stanford, and Georgetown.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局已对50人提起诉讼，他们涉嫌参与一项数百万美元的贿赂计划，将富家子弟送入耶鲁大学、斯坦福大学和乔治敦大学等名校。

sentences.en: The scheme included payoffs of between $15,000 and $75,000 to a man who took SAT and ACT exams in place of students, or later corrected students' answers,
sentences.zh: 该计划包括向一名代替学生参加SAT和ACT考试或事后修改学生答案的男子支付15000至75000美元不等的酬金，

sentences.en: and to a man and woman who administered the tests at different schools in California and Texas.
sentences.zh: 以及向加利福尼亚州和得克萨斯州不同学校的主考男女人员支付酬金。

sentences.en: Today we have charged 33 parents nationwide.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们在全国范围内对33名家长提出了指控。

sentences.en: These parents are a catalog of wealth and privilege.
sentences.zh: 这些家长堪称财富和特权的代名词。

sentences.en: They include, for example, CEOs of private and public companies, successful securities and real estate investors, two well-known actresses, a famous fashion designer,
sentences.zh: 例如，他们包括私营和上市公司首席执行官、成功的证券和房地产投资者、两位知名女演员、一位著名的时装设计师，

sentences.en: and the co-chairman of a global law firm.
sentences.zh: 以及一家全球律师事务所的联席主席。

sentences.en: Among those charged were the actresses Felicity Huffman of Desperate Housewives and Lori Loughlin of Full House,
sentences.zh: 被起诉的人中包括出演《绝望的主妇》的女演员菲丽西提·霍夫曼和出演《欢乐满屋》的女演员洛莉·洛夫林，

sentences.en: who both allegedly paid bribes to have their children admitted to elite colleges.
sentences.zh: 两人据称都曾行贿以让自己的孩子进入精英高校。

sentences.en: There can be no separate college admissions system for the wealthy, and I'll add there will not be a separate criminal justice system either.
sentences.zh: 富人绝不能有单独的高校招生系统，我要补充的是，也不会有单独的刑事司法系统。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日》节目的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴尔巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《导购秀》节目中，我们正为假期接待亲友做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人在家般温馨的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是深度睡眠者吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片才睡着的。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》App或你喜欢的任何播客平台上搜索《导购秀》。

sentences.en: Or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 或在任何你喜欢的地方收听。
